run_detection_model_training: run a detection model training pipeline using a LazyConfig python config file with DDP support
run_model_evaluation: run evaluation on a detection model using a test dataloader and evaluator from config
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a saved checkpoint using DetectionCheckpointer with resume flag
review_do_train_function: review the do_train function that instantiates models, optimizers, and registers training hooks
review_do_test_function: review the do_test function that runs inference on a dataset and prints CSV results
